description: The Hobo Cues is a versatile everyday gravel bike for daily use, commuting, leisure and touring. With a frame made of robust steel, comfortable flat bar and space for wide gravel tyres, it is easy to handle and comfortable on daily journeys over roads or gravel. The focus is on stability and comfort and, thanks to the integrated front luggage rack as well as additional mounting points, it is suitable for everything from spontaneous excursions to relaxed bikepacking tours. Characteristics and advantages The Hobo Cues weighs approx. 12.9 kg1 and is equipped with the mechanical Shimano Cues groupset with 1x10 gears. The wide gearing with 40 teeth at the front and 11-48 teeth at the rear is beginner-friendly even on changing terrain. With Linkglide technology, the Cues stands for smooth shifting and high durability. Gear indicator and single-hand operation make handling even easier. + Wide range of uses + Easy handling + Robust and low-maintenance Ideal for: • everyone looking for an uncomplicated gravel bike for everyday use • commuting, leisure rides and relaxed tours • bikepacking without a sporty focus • mixed terrain: road, gravel and easy off-road terrain • riders who prioritise comfort and robustness in daily use • riders who prefer a flat bar to a drop bar Less suitable for: • gravel cycling with a focus on speed • rough terrain and demanding trails • long distances, many metres of climbing and a sporty ambition Highlights: • 25CrMo4 steel frame – stable, durable and comfortable • Carbon fork – less weight and added comfort • Flat handlebar – relaxed riding with plenty of control • Hobo Base Rack front luggage rack – standard for small luggage • Extension rack for large luggage items available as an accessory • 55 mm tyre clearance – for urban, gravel and MTB tyres up to 2.1” • Hydraulic disc brakes – safe braking without compromise • 14 mounting points on the frame and fork – plenty of space for bags and accessories • Ready for commuting and everyday life – mudguard and kickstand separately available • UDH mounting standard – future-proof for all shifting systems Other features: The steel gravel bike Hobo 'Cues' comes with Shimano's mechanical Cues groupset, 1x10 gears and gravel gearing. Shimano disc brakes and 47 mm WTB Venture tyres provide safety, grip and added comfort. Sturdy Rose G20* aluminium wheels in the agile 650B size are fitted, suitable for city traffic. The Low Riser handlebar from Ergotec and a Silverado saddle from WTB provide ergonomic comfort at your contact points. All parts are robust and proven, for many kilometres in any weather. * G30 for Cotton Candy frame colour Note: Pedals are not included. 1 may vary up to +/- 5 % due to manufacturing tolerances, reference frame colour cosmic cassis, size M, without pedals
